items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I would go to work one night and here's Howard Roberts, John Gray, they all would come in and we would play and really get some kicks.

ctx.x: me in that Bobby played piano, but not too much piano. He wanted to get up and sing and stand up, so consequently I had to do all the playing. So I got a chance to be the accompanist, the soloist, and I stayed with Bobby for about five years, and really got it together. You know. So consequently everybody around Hollywood starting becoming aware of me, and I got an awful lot of recordings, and started doing quite a bit of studio work, you know. I had a few shows and this, you know.

But that was the perfect job and the perfect situation because Bobby is a beautiful person. And he loves musicians, he admires musicians, he respects musicians, and it's -- everybody loves him. All the guitarists would come in. I would go to work one night and here's Howard Roberts, John Gray, they all would come in and we would play and really get some kicks. And Bobby loved guitarists too, as you know. So that was a very good job for me at that time, because I got my chops together --
